# Relayeo Sovereign Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Specification
> The Open Standard for LLM Citation Disambiguation, Machine Extractability, and Autonomous Agent Discovery.

## Canonical Identity
- Brand: Relayeo
- Platform: https://www.relayeo.com
- Category: Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) & Machine Entity Authority Protocol
- Author: Ghanashyam Prabhakar
- CLI: npx relayeo-audit <domain>

## Core Machine Feeds
- /llms.txt: Standardized token-efficient plain text corpus for RAG chunkers.
- /robots.txt: Permissive access directives for GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and PerplexityBot.
- /.well-known/agent-manifest.json: W3C & ADP v2.0 machine capability manifest.
- Schema.org @graph: Disambiguated JSON-LD entity graph with W3C @id URI resolution.

## Diagnostic Benchmark
Use the open-source CLI to test any domain against 14 vector ingestion criteria:
```bash
npx relayeo-audit yourdomain.com
```
Full interactive audits and production feeds available at https://www.relayeo.com
